author: morbianai
text:
Everyone is arguing whether GTA 6 will even hit 60 fps on PC.

I got it running at native 4K and a locked 120.

$100 Claude subscription, an RTX 5090 and 2 sleepless nights.

Here's what Claude Code did:

• Profiled every frame to find where the 8 ms were going
• Moved shadows to async compute, the last 14 fps came from there
• Switched to native 3840x2160, no upscaling
• Set the present interval from 2 to 1 for a true 120 Hz
• Split crowd simulation across CPU cores

Frame time 8.3 ms, 1% low 117 fps. Consoles run this game at 30.

Who wants to know more - DM me.

GTA 6 PC PORT UPDATE 🚨

While CGBJ has been taken down, a community launcher called MandyHub has emerged.

It fetches different PC port projects from PortWatch, compiles them locally, manages updates and offers graphics presets for AMD and NVIDIA users.

I've looked through the launcher's source code and found no obvious malware. However, it executes third-party code without sandboxing, so use it at your own risk.
